## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7f65b2c7be4b180ae909bfead22676379ca4f289`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the whole diff of #36788, `git diff e0f0e9f7da7355b84da76e13821ba18a082eb9ec 7f65b2c7be4b180ae909bfead22676379ca4f289` (38 files, 7 commits), plus the L1 delta `601ea667..7f65b2c7` (17 files, 3 commits). Contract face (the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration): `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`, `.changeset/36741-full-page-inbox.md`. Files in the diff that consume it: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/inbox/{InboxPage,InboxPageDetail,InboxPageList,inboxPageModel,useInboxPageApprovals}.ts(x)`, `layout/{InboxPopover,InboxBell}.tsx`, `hooks/{useInboxBell,sharedUserFeeds,useInboxArrivalNotifier}.ts`, `console/{AppContent.tsx,appRouteMetadataReads.ts}`, `console/home/HomePage.tsx`, and the test suites in the diff (`InboxPage-36741`, `inboxPageModel-36741`, `useInboxPageApprovals-36741`, `InboxPopover.fullPage-36741`, the Home and arrival-notifier link pins, `vite-declared-lazy-views`). Cited and read only: `RecordDetailView.tsx` (the `embedded` comment rule, `useApprovalQueueAdvance`), `components/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx`, `utils/appRoute.ts` (`resolveNotificationTarget`), `layout/{PhoneAppNavBar,openInboxNotification}.tsx`, `ui/packages/{i18n,app-shell}/package.json`, `.changeset/config.json`, other app-shell changesets, AGENTS.md's changeset rule. Also searched `content/`, `skills/`, `docs/qa/`, `packages/qa/` and the sibling checkouts hotcrm, cloud and docs.objectos.ai for the old link, the old zh wording and the bell's test ids.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the diff and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The PR body was read for context. The head matches the PR's `head.sha`; it did not move. The PR is still a draft.

### ① Derived judgments

**The widening declaration is right and complete.**
- One new top-level block, `inboxPage`, with the same 14 keys in all eleven shipped packs: `backToList`, `openFullRecord`, `occurrences`, `moreApprovals`, `goApprove`, `loadEarlier`, `loadEarlierFailed`, `pickApproval`, `pickItem`, `openRequest`, `nextHint`, `openLink`, `unreadOnly`, `allApprovals`. No pack had an `inboxPage` block on the base, so nothing collides. `@object-ui/i18n` publishes the packs through `./locales` and `./locales/*`, so this widens a published surface.
- No value has a placeholder, and no call site passes one. Every `t('inboxPage.*')` call in app-shell names one of the 14 keys, and its `defaultValue` matches the en pack word for word.
- No key is removed or renamed. The only other pack edits change text: zh-Hans and zh-Hant `sidebar.inbox` (消息中心 / 訊息中心 → 收件箱) and `sidebar.inboxAriaLabel` (打开消息中心 / 開啟訊息中心 → 打开收件箱 / 開啟收件箱). The new zh-Hant wording matches the 收件箱 that pack already uses elsewhere (`openInbox`, the auth mail screens). No test, doc or sibling checkout matches on the old Chinese text; the only remaining hit is a code comment in cloud.
- No new export from a published package's index. The new exports (`postInboxReadReceipts`, `fetchPendingApprovalPage`, `readEarlierInboxMessages`, `refreshSharedInbox`, `SHARED_INBOX_WINDOW`, `approverIdentities`) are module exports inside `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is `private: true`. `InboxPopover` gains an optional prop, `opensPageOnDesktop`, that defaults to `false`, so the `global:notifications` page block and any other host keep the panel.

**The translations are reasonable.** zh-Hans 只看未读 / 全部审批 / 去审批 › / 处理后自动跳到下一条 · J / K 上下切换 read naturally. zh-Hant is a faithful conversion (載入, 檢視, 開啟). en, de, fr, es, pt-BR, ja, ko, ar and ru are idiomatic or close to it. ko uses 결재 for approval, as that pack does elsewhere. The eight packs other than Chinese and English have not been reviewed by a native speaker.

**Read state.**
- «Mark all read» (`InboxPage.tsx:153-165`): when the bell's own 20-row window still holds an unread row, it goes through `bell.markAllRead()`. Otherwise it posts `read/all` itself through `postInboxReadReceipts`. Both paths send the server's read-all receipt, so older rows loaded on this page are read after a reload too. If nothing is unread, it does nothing.
- On arrival the page shows a row without marking it read: `autoPicked` is set at `:227-230` and checked at `:254`. A click (`pick`, `:198-208`, including a click on the row already shown), J / K (`:243`) or an address that names the row marks the whole coalesced row read. That goes through the bell's write for rows in the window, and a direct `read` receipt for older rows (`:132-151`). Then the shared feed is read again, so the sidebar badge drops.
- The phone: `isDesktopViewport()` (`inboxPageModel.ts:145`) reads `window.innerWidth` at the moment it is called, at the same 768 px breakpoint as `useIsMobile`. It guards both the auto-pick (`InboxPage.tsx:227`) and the bell's switch to the page link (`InboxPopover.tsx:555`). So on the first frame, before `useIsMobile` has measured, a phone neither picks a row nor gets the page link.

**Approvals.** `useInboxPageApprovals.ts:49,58-61` asks the shared feed to read again once for each bus nonce (`answeredNonce` moves when it is handled). A later re-read caused by a change in `sharedTotal` does not ask again, so the two reads cannot trigger each other. `refreshSharedPendingApprovals` only calls `approvalsFeed.pushedChange()` and puts nothing on the bus. A decided request hands the selection to the next row through `selectionAfterLeaving`. The embedded record view turns off its own queue advance when embedded (`RecordDetailView.tsx:1421-1424`), so the two cannot both move the selection.

**Routing from the bell and the other doors.**
- `inbox` and `inbox/:inboxTab` are added to `APP_ROUTE_CHUNKS`, to the route table and to `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` (`object`, `page`).
- The desktop bell is a plain button. Through the unsaved-edits guard it goes to `inboxPagePath(hostAppSegment)`, and on the page itself it carries `aria-current="page"` and stays put.
- No hook comes after the early return in `InboxPopover`.
- A linkless arrival toast (`useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts:128`) and Home's two inbox links (`HomePage.tsx:1079,1095`) now go to the page. The link pins were updated to `/apps/<app>/inbox`.
- The phone's panel «View all» (`InboxPopover.tsx:403`) and `PhoneAppNavBar.tsx:96` keep the `sys_inbox_message?view=mine` list, which the Acceptance notes state.

**The text now matches the code.** Both the PR body and the changeset say the right pane shows no comments and that a reply goes through «Open full record». That matches `RecordDetailView.tsx:1346-1347`, which hides comments when embedded. They also say the row shown on arrival stays unread. The row-offset paging gap («Load earlier») is stated in the Acceptance notes.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n` (published) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (private). That follows AGENTS.md's changeset rule: a widening that is not a protocol change ships `patch`. The pair matches the other app-shell + i18n changesets in `.changeset/`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Language-pack keys are not something a metadata author writes, and no spec key, accepted value or metadata type moves.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right. It starts its line in both the PR body and the changeset, and `Metadata-protocol: none` starts the next line in both. No `major`: nothing is removed, and no text a consumer matches on by key changes in a way that breaks it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Pins fail without the fix, by reading.**
  - `«Mark all read» reaches the server when only older loaded rows are unread` asserts `postInboxReadReceipts('read/all')` and that `bell.markAllRead` is not called. On 601ea667 it fails.
  - `shows the first row on arrival without reading it` asserts that `markManyRead` is not called.
  - `a phone shows the list and picks nothing by itself` fails on 601ea667: the real `useIsMobile` returns `false` on the first frame.
  - `asks the shared feed to read again once per decision` counts `refresh` calls: 1 after the decision, still 1 after two `sharedTotal` moves, 2 after a second decision. On 601ea667 it fails.
- **No test was weakened.** The old «marks it read on arrival» assertion now runs on an explicit click (`reads a row the user opens…`). The Home and toast pins change only the expected target. The panel pins (`AppHeader.inboxVariant`, `AppHeader.deferredChromeReads-12980`, `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces`) draw at phone width, with their assertions unchanged.
- **The two late commits are test-only and follow existing patterns.** `import '@objectstack/lint'` in `HomePage.openMarksRead` matches what five other app-shell suites already do, and app-shell declares the dependency. `vi.mock(..., importOriginal)` for `@object-ui/auth` and `@object-ui/react` in `useInboxPageApprovals-36741` keeps the real modules apart from the one hook each test replaces.
- **Downstream consumers.** The i18n change only adds keys, plus a zh text change to two existing keys. The desktop bell no longer opens a `Sheet`: an out-of-tree e2e that clicks the sidebar bell at ≥768 px and waits for the panel will now land on `/apps/<app>/inbox` instead. hotcrm, cloud and docs.objectos.ai hold no such selector.
- **SQL / id materialization.** Not touched. This is a client-only change that reuses the existing reads (`sys_inbox_message` joined to `sys_notification_receipt` through the data API, `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests`) and writes (`POST /api/v1/notifications/read[/all]`).
- **Author.** The PR's `user.login` is `os-warren`, not `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

This PR's surfaces are the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone. They include no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing, so ④ is not required. For the record:
- Drawing every subject with `RecordDetailView` in its `embedded` form is better than an inbox-specific renderer. Decisions run the request's own declared actions, with their own `visible` rules.
- Reading the viewport directly for the one decision that cannot wait for `useIsMobile`, while keeping the hook for the layout, is the smallest fix that is correct on the first frame.

Findings:

- **N1:** The auto-pick writes `?item=<id>` into the address (with `replace`). An address that names a row counts as the user opening it. So reloading the page, or coming Back to it after leaving through the sidebar, marks the row that was only shown on arrival as read. This is narrower than the original N1, but the changeset's «the row the page shows on arrival stays unread until it is opened» does not hold across a reload.
- **N2:** Two module comments still describe the old behaviour. `InboxPage.tsx:17` says «Selecting a notification marks it read», but a shown row is not read. `InboxPageDetail.tsx:14` says a notification's record is shown «its discussion included», but the embedded record hides its comments.
- **N3:** Three platform-checklist items drive the bell's popover by opening the bell: `platform-core.notification-center`, `approvals.pending-count-surfaces` (the popover header's `<total> total · …` line) and `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears`. At ≥768 px the bell now opens the page, so a run at desktop width will not find the popover. The items need a phone width or re-pointing at the page, in this PR or a follow-up.
- **N4:** On a phone, two different "all notifications" destinations now coexist. Home's inbox links and a linkless toast open `/apps/<app>/inbox` (in its list-first phone layout), while the bell panel's «View all» and the phone nav bar open the `sys_inbox_message` list. This is consistent with "the phone keeps its panel", but the changeset does not say that Home and the toast reach the page at every width.
- **N5:** `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx:1203-1204` says clicking an approval notification in the bell "opens that request's drawer directly". On desktop the request is now embedded in the inbox page's right pane, and «Open» leads to the drawer. This was loose wording before the PR; it is now one step off.
- **N6:** The eight packs other than Chinese and English (ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru) have not been reviewed by a native speaker.

**VERDICT: PASS**
